result.brief: 将预训练视频扩散模型复用为通用潜在动作学习器，从时空特征中提取紧凑、与外观解耦的潜在动作，实现跨具身零样本动作迁移与紧凑策略学习。
result.reason: Repurposes pretrained video diffusion features into compact latent action space (1200→4 tokens), disentangling dynamics from appearance; a video representation contribution with cross-embodiment transfer.
